top_violation_types.title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired (26 TAC §746.4751(c))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: There are pieces of wood on the playground and the fence has an opening.

top_violation_types.title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation knowingly allowed persons to be present at the operation before receiving notification from the CBCU that the persons eligibility determination is Eligible, Provisional or Eligible with Conditions.

top_violation_types.title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less (26 TAC §746.4907(a)(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation's play structures did not have the correct depth of loose fill. The play structures need six inches of loose fill.

top_violation_types.title: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, relocation, and sheltering/lock-down procedures (26 TAC §746.5202(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation is missing how they would evacuate children younger then 24 months out of the operation doing an emergency.

top_violation_types.title: Background Check Validation - You must inactivate a subject who is no longer associated with your operation within 7 days of leaving (26 TAC §745.651(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Based on information obtained during the investigation, it was determined that an employee who left in October 2025 was not inactivated until February 2026.

top_violation_types.title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3407(12))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A cleaning bottle was not labeled in a classroom with children present.

top_violation_types.title: Required Admission Information-Physician Information (26 TAC §744.605(11))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Child files were reviewed.  1 child still needs health care information for admission form.

top_violation_types.title: Responsibilities - Not interfere with an inspection or investigation (26 TAC §745.8411(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Recite: The child care provider was not cooperative with the investigation and inspection process even with law enforcement presence.
